adversarial_claim: The executor of a task, also registered as an evaluator, assesses its own task and earns task_quality credit for it.

events.rationale: Draft 14.5, row 'Execution completed with data returned': EXECUTION, SUCCESS, reliability; counts toward reliability. The signer is registered as executor (A.2 reporter_role) and the cited record names the declared executor (14.2).

Draft 14.6 rule 5: the signer is registered as executor for this task (it reported the task's execution) and MUST NOT be accepted as evaluator for the same task. Its evaluator registration is a second trust record of the same iss. UNQUALIFIED reports contribute nothing (14.3).
